evidence.locator: I/355/gaiadr3 around M33 (src/objects/m33-layers/source/lggs-stars/gaia-dr3-foreground.csv): Source, RA_ICRS, DE_ICRS, Plx, e_Plx, pmRA, e_pmRA, pmDE, e_pmDE, Gmag. Query: SELECT Source, RA_ICRS, DE_ICRS, Plx, e_Plx, pmRA, e_pmRA, pmDE, e_pmDE, Gmag FROM "I/355/gaiadr3" WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', RA_ICRS, DE_ICRS), CIRCLE('ICRS', 23.4621, 30.6599, 0.75)) AND ((Plx > 0.02 AND e_Plx < 0.2 * Plx) OR (ABS(pmRA) > 0.2 + 2 * e_pmRA AND e_pmRA < 0.2 * ABS(pmRA)) OR (ABS(pmDE) > 0.2 + 2 * e_pmDE AND e_pmDE < 0.2 * ABS(pmDE)))
